known_issues: Physical Windows tray/bootstrap/autostart/removable-drive integration is not yet validated on a real user machine.
Autostart trusts any drive carrying the matching .kohakuyasha-id marker and Kohakuyasha.bat (low risk, needs same UUID).
Instance lock file lives on the (possibly removable) project drive.
Physical Windows: user confirmed Kohakuyasha.bat v0.1.4 launches and works; tray menu, full diagnostics, restart and autostart/drive-letter checks not individually confirmed.
API key is stored in plain text in data/secrets.json (git-ignored, chmod 600 best effort). Windows DPAPI encryption is a candidate improvement.
Memory is retrieval-based (SQLite FTS5 with crude Russian prefix stemming), not model fine-tuning; semantic embeddings are a possible later upgrade.

Cloud.ru endpoint https://foundation-models.api.cloud.ru/v1 and model ids deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash / deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro follow Cloud.ru catalog naming but could not be verified offline; both are editable in the cabinet.
Cloud.ru calls are verified with mocks and a local fake server only, not with a real key.
Fact extraction and summaries cost extra short provider requests (one per N user messages; configurable) and are verified with mocks and a local fake provider only.
Retrieval is lexical (FTS5 + crude Russian stemming); semantic embeddings remain future work.
After a rollback the SQLite schema stays at the newer version (older code ignores extra tables).

The Windows relaunch after an update is covered by unit tests and a real two-process lock-race test on Linux; confirm on physical Windows that the app comes back by itself after «Перезапустить сейчас».
Диск Kohakuyasha: uploads/downloads verified on Linux and in Chromium only; file-name rules for Windows are enforced but not yet exercised on a real Windows drive.
next_action: Merge v0.13.1 on user request, then stage 3: voice/TTS, hotkeys, character profiles, semantic search, chat attachments.
